name: handler_winprogressbar
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as a MS Windows Progress Bars in the GUI

origin.description: Report progress with a utils Windows progress bar.
origin.usage: handler_winprogressbar(intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.gui", 1), target = "gui", inputs = list(title = NULL, label = "message"), ...)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: inputs
arguments.text: Which message updates the title and the label. "message" means both non_sticky_message and sticky_message. The default sets title from nothing and label from any message.
Further named arguments. make_progression_handler arguments stay on the handler. The rest are passed to winProgressBar.

origin.details: On unix this stops with handler_winprogressbar requires MS Windows and the quoted OS type, before inputs are checked. An unnamed extra argument is rejected before that OS check. On Windows the bar is utils winProgressBar. An empty label is stored as a space so later updates can change it. clear TRUE closes the bar. clear FALSE sets the current step.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_winprogressbar(enable = TRUE), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_winprogressbar stops with ", err, ".\n", sep = "")
